# Run 6 — sdh-spot-check, electron side: n = +3.2e12 cm^-2, D = 0, B 0 -> 10 T (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above), sr1 50 uV
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

r = run(6)
print(summarize_run(r))
I_bias = 1.0 / r.meta["measurement_config"]["bias_resistor"]  # sr1 drive 1 V / 100 MOhm = 10 nA
B = r.col("magnet_field"); o = np.argsort(B); B = B[o]
R = r.col("sr1_X")[o] / I_bias  # sr1 unity gain (device card)

# --- raw first ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
ax.set_title(f"run 6 raw: Rxx(B) at n = +3.2e12, D = 0, T = {r.col('T_sample').mean():.2f} K")
plt.show()

# --- onset (per-tone, matched-filter) ---
on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / I_bias)
print(on.summary())

# --- FFT in 1/B above onset; stability over cutoff and bg_degree; model overlay (fs_count_b0, n = +3.2e12) ---
F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(3.2e16))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
for co, deg, sty in ((on.onset_b, 5, "-"), (max(on.onset_b * 1.3, 1.0), 5, "--"), (on.onset_b, 7, ":")):
    f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(co, B.max()), bg_degree=deg)
    norm = s[0][f > 3].max()
    ax.plot(f, s[0] / norm, sty, lw=1, label=f"cutoff {co:.2f} T, deg {deg}")
for x, lab in ((7.31, "ABAB light 7.31"), (25.78, "ABAB heavy 25.78"), (F_L, f"F_L / ABCA {F_L:.1f}")):
    ax.axvline(x, color="k", lw=0.7, alpha=0.5); ax.text(x, 1.02, f" {lab}", rotation=90, va="bottom", fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(0, 45); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.6)
ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm to f > 3 T max)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
ax.set_title("run 6 SdH FFT vs model tones (fs_count_b0 at n = +3.2e12)")
plt.show()

# Run 7 — sdh-spot-check, hole side: n = -1.2e12 cm^-2, D = 0, B 10 -> 0.3 T (20 mT, ride-down), sr1 50 uV
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

r = run(7)
print(summarize_run(r))
I_bias = 1.0 / r.meta["measurement_config"]["bias_resistor"]  # 10 nA
B = r.col("magnet_field"); o = np.argsort(B); B = B[o]
R = r.col("sr1_X")[o] / I_bias

# --- raw first ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
ax.set_title(f"run 7 raw: Rxx(B) at n = -1.2e12, D = 0, T = {r.col('T_sample').mean():.2f} K")
plt.show()

# --- onset ---
on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / I_bias)
print(on.summary())

# --- FFT + model overlay (fs_count_b0, n = -1.2e12: ABAB pair 5.86/6.54 T, ABCA 12.41 T with m* = 1.1 -> LK-dead at T_e ~ 8 K) ---
F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(1.2e16))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
for co, deg, sty in ((on.onset_b, 5, "-"), (on.onset_b * 1.3, 5, "--"), (on.onset_b, 7, ":")):
    f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(co, B.max()), bg_degree=deg)
    norm = s[0][f > 3].max()
    ax.plot(f, s[0] / norm, sty, lw=1, label=f"cutoff {co:.2f} T, deg {deg}")
for x, lab in ((5.86, "ABAB heavy 5.86"), (6.54, "ABAB light 6.54"), (F_L, f"F_L / ABCA {F_L:.1f}")):
    ax.axvline(x, color="k", lw=0.7, alpha=0.5); ax.text(x, 1.02, f" {lab}", rotation=90, va="bottom", fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(0, 20); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.6)
ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("FFT amp (norm to f > 3 T max)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
ax.set_title("run 7 SdH FFT vs model tones (fs_count_b0 at n = -1.2e12)")
plt.show()

**Read — runs 6 + 7 (Step 3 of `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`):**

- **Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T):** dominant tone **7.10 T** (SNR 40), alive to the record's low edge (onset censored at 0.3 T; the 50 mT leg below 1 T undersamples a 7 T tone, so the true onset is unpinned but ≤ ~1 T). 7.10 T sits **3% under the model's ABAB light pocket (7.31 T)** — inside the lever-arm scale prior. Secondary tones 14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T are flagged as ≈2×/3×/4× of 7.1, but the **ABAB heavy pocket (25.8 T model) lies between the 3× and 4× positions (21.3 / 28.4 T)** and the per-tone δF there (1.6–2.4 T) cannot close heavy-vs-harmonic per column. No peak at F_L = 33.1 T (ABCA singleton absent — hedged: ABCA m* = 0.074 mₑ is LK-damped at T_e ≈ 8 K). The censored 3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T tones live in the undersampled coarse leg — aliasing suspects, not reads.
- **Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T):** onset 0.71 T; tones 6.6 (dom), 4.7, 8.5 T, and **12.3 T ≈ F_L (SNR 125)**. Model ABAB pair here is 5.86/6.54 T — close and balanced (the investigation's stated low-|n| exception regime where ABAB mimics ABCA); a set {f₁, f₂, ≈F_L} is exactly the underdetermined constellation the recipe warns about. Not decisive by design; |n| on the hole side is capped at 1.27×10¹² by the TG −0.3 V limit.

**Verdict:** two-FS-leaning (ABAB-like) tone content on both sides, **not closable per-column** — the heavy-tone-vs-harmonic fork and the F_L-tone origin need F(n) trajectories. **Fan on the electron side** (design regime |n| ≥ 2×10¹² reachable, cleaner low-onset tone, templates separate there); spot-check acquisition (50 µV, τ = 0.3 s at settling floor) inherited. → Step 4, `landau-fan-vti`.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`), electron side, D = 0, n = +2.1 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.7 → 10 T uniform-1/B

> **05:31** · landau-fan-vti: electron side, D=0, n +2.1 to +3.2e12 (37 pts), B 0.7 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (133 rows, d(1/B)=0.0101), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 2.1 s; ends at 10 T, gates at n=+2.1e12 · **ETA ~10:16** (≈4h45m)

**Why this fan (from runs 6/7, ana):** run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹²) put the dominant tone at 7.10 T — 3% under the model's ABAB light pocket (7.31 T, `fs_count_b0`) — with the 22.1/29.5 T features unresolvable per-column between the ABAB heavy pocket (25.8 T) and 3×/4× harmonics of 7.1 (21.3/28.4 T). Run 7 (hole, |n| capped at 1.27×10¹² by the TG limit) sits in the low-|n| exception regime with an underdetermined {6.6, 4.7, ≈F_L} set. The discriminator is per-column FFT **F(n) trajectories**: a harmonic tracks 3×f_light(n) (11.6 → 21.9 T over this window), a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (17.9 → 25.8 T) — they never cross in-window — plus the Luttinger sum f₁+f₂ = F_L per column. Electron side per the spot checks: design regime (templates separate at |n| ≥ 2×10¹²), onset ≤ 0.7 T, SNR 40+.

**Design (recipe step-1 checks, computed):**
- **B axis**: `field_invB(0.7, 10.0, 133)` — Δ(1/B) = 0.01006 /T = 1/3-Nyquist on F_L(3.2×10¹²) = 33.1 T (unaliased to 49.7 T at 1/2). B_lo = 0.7 T: run 6's carrying tone is censored at its record edge (alive at 0.3 T) so 0.7 T is above onset for the tones this fan claims; it buys record 1.33 /T → δF = 0.75 T for tones alive from 0.7 T, and ≥5 periods of the ABAB partner at n_min (model partner 3.86 T at 2.1×10¹² → 5.1 periods). Heavy-tone per-column δF ≈ 2.3 T (its onset ~1.9 T) — per-column marginal, which is why the read is the cross-column trajectory.
- **n axis**: 37 pts, +3.2 → +2.1×10¹² (descending), step 0.031×10¹² ≤ half the ray spacing 4(e/h)·0.7 T = 0.068×10¹².
- **Dynamic range**: sr1 fixed 50 µV (5 kΩ FS at 10 nA), inherited from the spot checks; worst corner (n_min × 10 T) anchored by run 7's 576 Ω at |n| = 1.2, 10 T → ≥8× headroom.
- **Settling**: fast_delay = 2.1 s = 7τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB/oct — the settling floor (k = 7–10), required for a per-column FFT read; sr0/sr1 X+P per point.
- **Cost floor**: 133 × 37 grid at 2.2 s/pt (session-calibrated: run 5 measured 1.10 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0 → 0.1 s read overhead) = 3.0 h + traverse 0 → 0.7 → 10 T at 0.137 T/min = 73 min + 133 row settles/turnarounds ≈ 11 min → **4.4 h, headline 4 h 45 m** (session actuals run 5–10% over).

**Coverage trade, stated:** hole side excluded (TG −0.3 V caps it at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² — exception regime, already spot-checked as run 7); n < 2.1×10¹² excluded (partner tone < 5 periods above B_lo, and the templates converge below ~2×10¹²); a full 1.2 → 3.2 window at the same checks costs ~+2 h for columns whose partner tone is unresolvable. Price of the full-coverage variant, if the trajectory read ends ambiguous: one more fan.

**Ends at 10 T** with gates at the n-line end — the LK mass split / follow-ups ride the magnet down (never re-traverse). **Checkpoints:** first rows (~10 min: rail/leak/dead-channel, live via `hera-watch`); ~1 h (B ≈ 1 T, row digests); ~2 h 45 m (B ≈ 2 T: interim per-column FFT on the landed record, δF ≈ 1.1 T — continue/abandon with the call priced); completion. Abort = kernel interrupt (magnet completes its last setpoint; partial fan keeps its rows).

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n = +2.1 -> +3.2e12, B 0.7 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D0 = 0.0
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 2.1, 37)                  # 1e12 cm^-2, descending; step 0.031 <= half ray spacing at 0.7 T (0.034)
Ds = np.full_like(ns, D0)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtgs.min() and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max())
assert BG_MIN <= Vbgs.min() and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({len(ns)} pts), Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V")

# --- field axis: uniform in 1/B (per-column SdH-FFT fan); d(1/B) = 0.01006 = 1/3-Nyquist on F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T ---
B_vec = field_invB(0.7, 10.0, 133)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"B: {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows uniform-1/B, d(1/B) = {abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)).max():.5f} /T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
_tau = sr1.time_constant()
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 1.0               # 7*tau settling floor at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB/oct (per-column FFT read)
print(f"sr1 tau {_tau} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct -> fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s (7 tau)")
assert _tau <= 0.301, _tau

I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)                          # inherited from runs 6/7: 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA; worst corner (n=2.1, 10 T) anchor: run 7 peak 576 Ohm
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron: D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = +2.1 to +3.2e12 (37 pts), B 0.7 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (133 rows), "
                  f"sr1 50 uV, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s (run-5 cal)")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = +2.1 to +3.2e12 cm^-2 (37 pts, descending), '
              f'B = 0.7 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (133 rows, d(1/B) = 0.01006 = 1/3-Nyquist on F_L = 33.1 T); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'follows sdh-spot-checks runs 6/7 (onset <= 0.7 T, sens/settling inherited)')

# position: blocking ramp to B_lo (~5 min from 0 T), then gates to the line start
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg_volt, k_bg_volt, T_sample, k_tg_curr, k_bg_curr, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B = {float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg = {float(data[2]):+.4f} V: |I_tg| = {i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg| = {i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs], slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# ends at 10 T, gates at the n-line end (n = +2.1e12) — follow-ups ride the magnet down; no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
